title: Digital Root
prompt: A math practice screen reduces a number to one digit. Write a function that repeatedly sums the digits of a non-negative integer until a single digit remains, then returns it. For example, 942 becomes 9 + 4 + 2 = 15, then 1 + 5 = 6.

explanation.beginner:
Example: digitalRoot(942) produces 6. The result must follow this precise rule: A math practice screen reduces a number to one digit. Write a function that repeatedly sums the digits of a non-negative integer until a single digit remains, then returns it. For example, 942 becomes 9 + 4 + 2 = 15, then 1 + 5 = 6. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “reduces 99 to 9”: input [99] produces 9. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
